title: Relaxed Gaussian surface area
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and $A\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n$. Define the relaxed Gaussian surface area of $A$ as the infimum, over all surface-approximating sequences $(f_m)$ for $A$, of $\liminf_{m\to\infty}\int_{\mathbb{R}^n}|\nabla f_m(x)|\,d\gamma_n(x)$, where $\gamma_n$ is standard Gaussian measure and $|\nabla f_m(x)|$ is the Euclidean length of the gradient.
